title: Technical Web Growth Engineer
description:
Core Objective & Success Metric
Your single North Star is to increase incoming organic traffic and bring high-intent customers directly to our platforms . Success is not measured in vanity pageviews—it is measured by consistently generating a few qualified, interested organic leads every week from decision-makers actively searching for a solution.

About the Role
This is not a traditional marketing role . We are looking for a hands-on Web Growth Engineer - a builder who can code, ship, optimize, and measure.
You will take end-to-end technical and growth ownership of two B2B technology and SaaS web properties that currently have minimal content and untapped organic potential. Instead of writing audit decks for someone else to implement, you will build and improve the sites yourself, engineer their technical SEO/AEO foundations, ship fresh high-intent content pages directly to production, and wire up analytics to turn organic searchers into weekly inbound leads.

Key Responsibilities
1. Web Development & Site Building
Build, refactor, and deploy fast, responsive websites, landing pages, and modular page templates from scratch—leveraging AI coding tools and LLMs to accelerate prototyping, refactoring, and shipping.
Ship UI/UX improvements, layout upgrades, and conversion-focused components directly to production using clean HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks or lightweight CMS workflows with the goal to generate inquiries.
Maintain clean Git repositories, automated deployments, and fast, low-overhead hosting setups.
2. Technical Optimization (SEO, AEO, E-E-A-T & ASO)
Engineer rock-solid technical foundations: Core Web Vitals (90+ Lighthouse scores) , semantic HTML, clean URL structures, internal linking graphs, XML sitemaps, and crawlability.
Implement comprehensive Schem a.org JSON-LD structured data (Organization, SoftwareApplication, Service, FAQPage, Article etc) to win rich snippets and maximize visibility in both traditional search engines (Google) and AI answer engines / LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude).
Architect and deploy programmatic SEO pages (e.g., use-case matrices, integration pages, industry-specific landing pages) and strengthen E-E-A-T signals across both domains to bring relevant traffic with intent to inquire about services.
Support ASO (App Store Optimization) and cross-platform discoverability where relevant.
3. High-Intent Content Engineering & Publishing
Conduct keyword, competitor, and buyer-intent research focused on commercial and bottom-of-funnel queries—targeting people ready to evaluate or buy.
Produce, structure, and publish fresh content pages—including product/service pages, technical guides, comparison pages, FAQs, and case studies.
Collaborate with engineering and leadership to turn real technical capabilities into clear, accurate web copy, using AI-assisted workflows to move fast without sacrificing factual accuracy or editorial quality.
4. Analytics, Funnel Tracking & Conversion Optimization (CRO)
Set up, maintain, and debug GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager , and custom lead/event tracking across both web properties.
Monitor organic impressions, crawl health, keyword velocity, AI search citations, and lead-form conversion rates using GSC, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and Screaming Frog.
Continuously iterate on page speed, messaging, CTAs, and lead-capture flows based on real user data to maximize qualified weekly inquiries.

Requirements
Hands-on Web Builder ( 2–4 ye ars): Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Git, and modern static/SSR web stacks or lightweight CMS platforms. You can build and deploy a production-ready page without waiting on another developer.
Technical SEO & AEO Mastery: Proven experience scaling organic traffic from low/zero baselines using technical SEO, Schema.org markup, Core Web Vitals optimization, E-E-A-T, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).
AI & LLM Fluency: Active, practical experience using LLMs and AI developer/content tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor), schema generation, technical audits, and structured content workflows—while applying strict human judgment and quality control.
Analytics & Conversion Fluency: Comfortable configuring GA4, GTM, and GSC from scratch, diagnosing indexing issues, and optimizing funnels to drive actual leads—not just clicks.
Technical Content Execution: Strong written English with the ability to create structured, authoritative B2B and technical web content.
Builder Mindset: Self-directed, biased toward shipping, and comfortable owning code, content, and lead-generation metrics under one roof.
Nice to Have
Experience building programmatic SEO pipelines or automated content workflows.
Familiarity with ASO (Google Play / Apple App Store) and mobile growth analytics.
Exposure to B2B SaaS, enterprise IT, or developer-focused products.

Employment Type: Full-Time, Onsite, Karachi

What Success Looks Like
First 30 Days: Audit both web properties, fix critical performance/crawl/indexing issues, wire up clean GA4/GSC lead-tracking events, and ship upgraded core landing pages with full Schema.org markup.
First 60 Days: Launch a steady cadence of fresh, high-intent commercial content and programmatic pages engineered for both Google Search and AI answer engines.
First 90 Days: Reach a consistent baseline of a few qualified, interested organic leads per week , backed by measurable growth in high-intent non-branded traffic and indexed commercial keywords.
